audio_rate.rounding: Current official model page gives a per-minute rate but does not state a rounding rule. The ledger conservatively rounds measured PCM seconds up before multiplying by the tariff; do not present this as an invoice amount.

expected_increment.basis: Scenario only: five audio-bearing sources of at most 60 seconds each.
expected_increment.recognition_response_cost: Unknown before observed model usage; the original recognition cost scenario is not an empirical ASR forecast.

neutral_contract.permission: media.audio_allowed must be true; prohibited for visual_only, visual_pixel_text_masked and text_only.
neutral_contract.local_transcript: media.local_transcript:{path:'source/transcript.local.json',sha256}; evaluation-only generation receipt, full source timeline and exact PCM hash. No sidecar required for media without an audio stream.

latency_boundary.openai: Current extraction and API transcription latency included in observation elapsed_ms.
latency_boundary.local_retained: Current verification/extraction/load latency included; original local inference duration/hardware/configuration retained separately under inference_evidence.audio_evidence.trace. Original inference time is not silently counted as zero.
latency_boundary.retained: Original ASR generation time and cost unavailable, as in baseline.

provider_keys.openai_asr: MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY, matching production credential semantics. Never stored in inputs or receipts.

test_scope: Synthetic sources and model stubs only; production FFmpeg/probe/extraction and transcription provider plumbing tested without network requests. No local Whisper model process executed by infrastructure tests.
